dashboard.title: Cluster Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Members, memory consumption and the heaviest maps of cluster “{{cluster}}”
dashboard.membersHint: Members currently in the cluster; the master is the oldest member
dashboard.mapMemoryHint: Memory used by IMap entries on all members (owned primary copies vs backups)
dashboard.totalKeysHint: Owned entries of all maps (backups excluded)
dashboard.totalObjectsHint: All non-internal distributed objects in the cluster
dashboard.topMapsHint: Maps with the highest owned entry memory cost
dashboard.offlineText: The admin service keeps reconnecting in the background. Check the member addresses and the cluster name in the configuration.
dashboard.statsUnavailableText: Statistics come from member metrics, which are published every few seconds. They are missing when metrics are disabled on the members.

browser.predicateHint: Hazelcast SQL predicate syntax: =, !=, <, >, LIKE, ILIKE, IN, BETWEEN, AND, OR, NOT. Use __key for the key and this for scalar values.
browser.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.
browser.evictConfirmText: All entries of “{{name}}” that are not locked are evicted from memory. A configured MapStore is not called, so persisted data stays untouched.
browser.missingSchemas_one: {{count}} key or value on this page uses an IdentifiedDataSerializable class without a schema.
browser.missingSchemas_other: {{count}} keys or values on this page use IdentifiedDataSerializable classes without a schema.

inspector.title: Entry Inspector
inspector.ttlKeep: Leave empty to use the map default, 0 = never expire
inspector.ttlInvalid: TTL must be a whole number of seconds
inspector.notEditableWarning: The value could only be shown as text, so it cannot be edited here.
inspector.readOnlyHint: This value type cannot be edited from the UI (for example Portable records or collections).
inspector.invalidJson: The value is not valid JSON
inspector.editorHint: Edit the JSON value and save it back to the map
inspector.unresolvedTitle: The value could not be deserialized
inspector.unresolvedKeyTitle: The key could not be deserialized
inspector.unresolvedHint: Add the missing classes to admin.hazelcast.serialization.dto-classpath (and register factories/serializers if needed) to inspect it.
inspector.dtoSchemaHint: Paste the Java source of this class into the DTO Schema Studio and it becomes readable and editable right away.
inspector.configureDtoSchema: Configure DTO Schema (Factory ID: {{factoryId}}, Class ID: {{classId}})

putModal.title: Put Entry
putModal.jsonHint: Stored as HazelcastJsonValue and queryable with SQL predicates.
putModal.classHint: The JSON is bound to this class (from the admin or DTO classpath) before the put.
putModal.compactHint: Stored as a Compact record; the schema of the inspected value is reused.
putModal.generateTemplateHint: Replaces the editor content with every field of the DTO (nested DTOs included)
putModal.dtoHint: Written with the registered schema, byte-identical to the owning application. Nested DTOs carry "@classId"; dates are ISO-8601, BigDecimals and large longs are strings.

clearModal.title: Clear map
clearModal.warning: This permanently removes every entry of “{{name}}” on all members. This cannot be undone.

stats.nearCacheDisabled: No near cache is configured for this map on the members.

other.itemsUnavailable: This structure has {{size}} items, which is more than the configured fetch limit. Only the size is shown.
other.noBrowser: This structure type has no data browser. Its name and type are listed for reference.

notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist.

schemas.title: DTO Schema Studio
schemas.subtitle: Read and edit IdentifiedDataSerializable DTOs from their Java source, no jars needed
schemas.deleteConfirm: Delete the schema of {{name}} (factory {{factoryId}}, class {{classId}})? Values of this class become unreadable until it is added again.
schemas.pendingRestart: Schemas of factory id(s) {{ids}} are saved but not readable yet: the dynamic factory for a new factory id is registered on the next start of the service.
schemas.filterPlaceholder: Filter by class, class id or field…

factory.title: Factory
factory.empty: No factory parsed yet. Paste your DataSerializableFactory.java to map constants to class ids.

storage.title: Storage & factories
storage.fallback: fallback for class ids without a schema
storage.shareHint: Commit or share dto-schemas.json (Export / Import) so the whole team reads the same DTOs.

empty.title: No DTO schemas yet
empty.text: The admin service reads IdentifiedDataSerializable values once it knows the order and type of their fields. Three steps:
empty.step1Text: Paste DataSerializableFactory.java: FACTORY_ID and every class id (SOMEDTO = 1) are stored.
empty.step2Text: Paste SomeDTO.java: the readData calls become an ordered field list you can review.
empty.step3Text: Saved schemas apply immediately: open a map and its DTOs are shown and edited as JSON.

card.pendingHint: This factory id is not served by the running Hazelcast client yet; restart the service.

editor.saved: Schema {{name}} saved: its values are readable now
editor.savedRestart: Schema {{name}} saved; restart the service to read factory {{factoryId}}
editor.idsInvalid: Factory ID and Class ID must be integers, the class name a Java identifier.
editor.orderHint: Same order as the calls in readData: the order decides how the bytes are read.
editor.nestedHint: DTO class of the object / list elements (optional)
editor.nestedDisabled: Only NullableObject and NullableList fields contain DTOs
editor.noFields: No fields: add them in the order of readData.
editor.targetMismatch: The pasted class has class id {{parsed}}, the missing value has {{expected}}: check that this is the right class.

paste.title: Smart Java Paste
paste.factoryHint: Paste your factory: FACTORY_ID, all int constants and the class created for each id (switch, case/return, arrays or map.put) are extracted and stored.
paste.dtoHint: Paste a DTO with readData/writeData: the SerializationUtils and ObjectDataInput calls become the field list of the schema editor.
paste.targetHint: Missing in the cluster: {{name}} (Factory ID {{factoryId}}, Class ID {{classId}}). Paste its Java source.
paste.targetHintUnknown: Missing in the cluster: the class with Factory ID {{factoryId}}, Class ID {{classId}}. Paste its Java source (or parse the factory first to see its name).

import.title: Import dto-schemas.json
import.notRegistry: This is not a dto-schemas.json file (the "schemas" list is missing).
import.mergeHint: Adds the schemas and factory entries of the file; existing schemas with the same ids are overwritten.
import.replaceHint: Replaces the whole registry with the file. Schemas that are not in the file are removed.
